name: Home for the Holidays
source:
Welcome to Winter Haven! Who will you kiss under the mistletoe... your workaholic boss, your high school sweetheart, or your childhood friend?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Home_for_the_Holidays]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到冬季避风港！你会在槲寄生下亲吻谁……你的工作狂老板，你的高中恋人，还是你儿时的朋友？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Home_for_the_Holidays]Choices Wikia[/url]]
